task_info.original_instruction:
You need to send billing reminders to contacts at Pinnacle Industries. First, check your inbox for any unsubscribe requests and handle them according to the billing reminder guidelines in your manager's email.

Then, for contacts who have not requested to unsubscribe, send a billing reminder email with:
- Subject: "Pinnacle Industries - Invoice #INV-2024-0892 Payment Reminder"
- Body should include: the contact's first name, the invoice amount "$45,000", and payment due date "February 15, 2024"

After processing all contacts, update the account description to note that billing reminders were sent.

traj_info.agent_final_response:

- Found the billing reminder guidelines from Sarah, the Billing Manager.

- ✅ Sent billing reminder email to michael.torres@pinnacle-ind.com with:
  - Subject: "Pinnacle Industries - Invoice #INV-2024-0892 Payment Reminder"
  - Body including: First name (Michael), Invoice amount ($45,000), and Payment due date (February 15, 2024)

### Account Update:
- ✅ Updated Pinnacle Industries account description to: "Enterprise client - Manufacturing sector. Billing reminders sent on 2026-10-14"

All billing reminder guidelines have been followed, and contacts who requested to unsubscribe were handled appropriately while billing reminders were sent to active contacts.
